# scm_dlp_ocr_enablement (Resource)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] Manages Enterprise DLP Optical Character Recognition (OCR) enablement per target service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Enable OCR for Prisma Access traffic. Destroying this resource disables OCR
# for the target service.
resource "scm_dlp_ocr_enablement" "prisma_access" {
  target_service_name = "prisma-access"
  ocr_enablement      = "ENABLED"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ocr_enablement` (String) OCR enablement state. Valid values: REQUESTED, ENABLED, DISABLED.
- `target_service_name` (String) Target service name (e.g. prisma-access, ngfw, dlp).

### Read-Only

- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant identifier.
- `tfid` (String) Terraform identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import OCR enablement by target service name.
terraform import scm_dlp_ocr_enablement.example prisma-access
```
